semantics.active_rule: Every active canonical identity has exact current source definition.
semantics.superseded_rule: Superseded/deprecated definitions retain explicit replacement/history metadata.
semantics.duplicate_rule: Same canonical identity in active and history is valid only when history is excluded from active resolution.
semantics.projection_rule: Generated copies carrying canonical-like JSON do not participate unless explicitly definition-role accepted.
semantics.finding_rule: Any competing active source produces hard reconciliation finding.

invariants.rule: Whole-tree reconciliation operates only on exact accepted/candidate source snapshots, identities, references and declared semantics; it never repairs ambiguity through filename, path order, timestamp, nearest-name or UI layout heuristics.

A contract, closure set or repository remains unlocked/not-ready until all required reconciliation findings for its declared readiness profile are explicitly resolved or accepted through an explicit bounded exception.

hard_gates.condition: historical copy wins by newer mtime
history exclusion inferred only from folder color
